products.name: Graduated Pipettes Type-3 (Serological), Class A
products.short_description: Graduated Pipette, Serological, Class AS, Type-3, 5 ml, Batch Certified are supplied by Biohall. Pipettes are commonly used liquid handling glassware. products.name: Soxhlet Extractor, 500ml, Socket: 60/46 ,Cone:29/32
products.short_description: Soxhlet Extractor, 500ml, Socket: 60/46 ,Cone:29/32 is supplied by Biohall. The main application of the extractor is to separate impurities from substances.
